name: ProgressBarRoot
description:
Shows how far a task with a start and an end has progressed. Renders a `<div>` element.

Use `Meter` instead for a reading on a fixed scale, such as disk usage or a score.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value. The component is indeterminate when value is `null`.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the track. Controls its height. Default: `'md'`

props.name: type
props.description: Tone of the description text. Default: `'default'`

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: getAriaValueText
type: (formattedValue: string | null, value: number | null) => string
props.description:
Returns the value text read by assistive technology. Without it no
`aria-valuetext` is written, and `aria-valuenow` carries the value on its own.

The returned string also becomes the visible `ProgressBar.Value` text.

props.name: locale
props.description:
The locale used by `Intl.NumberFormat` when formatting the value.
Defaults to the user's runtime locale.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that

props.name: render
props.description:
